title: Automated Cross-Channel Performance Report Generator & Executive Summary Draft
description: Automate weekly ad platform data aggregation via APIs into Looker Studio, and use an LLM assistant to draft first-pass executive commentary highlighting key weekly variances for consultant review.
problem_statement: Consultants spend 14+ hours every week manually copying metrics across 3 ad platforms and typing formulaic commentary, causing high burnout and a 12% calculation error rate.
proposed_solution: API-based data ingestion pipeline combined with a prompt-engineered LLM drafter that compares current week vs prior week KPIs, flags key drivers, and pre-populates the commentary block for consultant review and 1-click signoff.
why_ai_or_why_not: Rule-based automation handles deterministic API metric pulls and variance math; LLM is used strictly to draft structured natural language commentary from structured KPI deltas.
data_readiness_notes: High readiness: Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Looker Studio schemas are well-structured and accessible via official APIs.
dependencies: Enterprise LLM API endpoint with Zero-Data-Retention
assumptions: Consultants require an average of 10 minutes to review and polish generated drafts rather than 75 minutes drafting from scratch.
API connectors remain stable with standard rate limits.
limitations: AI does not interpret external macro events (e.g. client website crash) unless manually flagged in prompt context.

financial_inputs.notes: Massive consultant capacity unlock across 1,456 weekly reports.

scoring_breakdown.explanation: High business value with strong data readiness, proven delivery model, and low operational friction.

title: Client Onboarding Orchestrator & Automated Asset Collection Hub
description: Trigger automated Asana board provisioning, Google Drive folder tree generation, and automated client asset reminder cadence upon deal Closed-Won status in HubSpot.
problem_statement: Manual folder creation, template duplication, and chasing client logins over email takes 8+ hours of Ops time per client and delays kickoff by 14 days.
proposed_solution: Webhook-driven integration between HubSpot, Asana, and Google Drive that auto-provisions standardized workspaces instantly and sends automated WhatsApp/Email reminders for missing access tokens.
why_ai_or_why_not: AI is unnecessary here. This is a deterministic orchestration workflow best solved with webhook automations, standardized folder templates, and scheduled reminder triggers.
data_readiness_notes: High readiness: Standard folder templates and Asana board blueprints already exist in Google Drive.
assumptions: Clients respond faster to an interactive checklist portal than scattered email threads.
Reduces administrative setup from 8 hours to 30 minutes per new client.
limitations: Third-party platform 2FA approvals still require human client intervention.

financial_inputs.notes: Reduces client onboarding cycle time from 14 days to 3 days.

scoring_breakdown.explanation: High business value with strong data readiness, proven delivery model, and low operational friction.

title: Smart Inbound Lead Enrichment & Routing Assistant
description: Instantly enrich inbound lead form submissions with company firmographics, classify intent signals using an LLM, and post an enriched summary card into Slack with 1-click Director assignment.
problem_statement: Junior SDRs spend 20 minutes researching every lead across LinkedIn and Google, creating a 2-4 hour latency before the lead receives outreach.
proposed_solution: Automated webhook captures form submit, enriches domain via Clearbit/Apollo API, uses an LLM to evaluate ICP match score, and posts an interactive Slack card allowing the Director to claim the lead with 1 click.
why_ai_or_why_not: APIs fetch firmographics; LLM classifies qualitative free-text 'tell us about your goals' responses into structured ICP score and pain categories.
data_readiness_notes: Moderate readiness: HubSpot form fields are structured; free-text notes require classification.
assumptions: Faster response time under 15 minutes increases discovery call conversion rate by 20%.
limitations: Leads with non-corporate email domains (e.g. gmail.com) require fallback to manual research.

financial_inputs.notes: Reduces response latency from 3 hours to 5 minutes.

scoring_breakdown.explanation: High business value with strong data readiness, proven delivery model, and low operational friction.

title: Proposal Knowledge Retrieval & Modular Slide Drafter
description: Implement semantic retrieval across 100+ past client proposals, case studies, and performance benchmarks to automatically assemble modular slide drafts and tailored strategy proposals.
problem_statement: Senior consultants spend 20 hours per pitch scouring Google Drive for past case studies, reformatting slides, and retyping strategy frameworks from scratch.
proposed_solution: Index historical case studies and pitch decks into a secure vector knowledge store. Allow consultants to input prospect profile and receive a modular 15-slide Google Slides draft with matching industry proof points and ROI models.
why_ai_or_why_not: LLM with semantic search (RAG) is essential to match unstructured prospect requirements to relevant past case studies across hundreds of historical presentations.
data_readiness_notes: Moderate readiness: Historical decks are in Google Drive but lack uniform tagging.
assumptions: Cuts proposal preparation time by 55% while maintaining bespoke quality.
Past proposals can be cleaned of confidential client names before indexing.
limitations: Requires strict review of pricing and proprietary strategies before dispatch.

financial_inputs.notes: Saves ~528 senior consultant hours annually on pitches.

scoring_breakdown.explanation: Substantial strategic upside; may require moderate integration effort or foundational data prep.

title: Contractor Timesheet & Invoice Automated 3-Way Reconciliation
description: Extract invoice line items from contractor PDF invoices using OCR, match against Asana milestone logs, and stage pre-coded bills in QuickBooks for 1-click Finance approval.
problem_statement: Month-end invoice matching takes 35+ hours of finance time, manually verifying 45 contractor bills against Asana task logs and rate agreements.
proposed_solution: Document parsing service extracts contractor name, hours, rate, and task references; matches against Asana completed task logs; flags variances over 5%; and drafts QuickBooks bills.
why_ai_or_why_not: OCR / Document AI extracts unstructured table fields from varied PDF layouts; rule-based script executes deterministic 3-way matching against Asana and QuickBooks.
data_readiness_notes: Moderate readiness: Invoices come in varying PDF formats; Asana task tagging needs standardization.
assumptions: 80% of contractor invoices adhere to agreed task reference formatting.
limitations: Handwritten or non-standard scanned receipts require manual handling.

financial_inputs.notes: Frees up 215 hours of finance time and saves $3.6k in bookkeeping fees.

scoring_breakdown.explanation: High business value with strong data readiness, proven delivery model, and low operational friction.

title: Client Meeting Intelligence & Action Item Synchronizer
description: Automatically summarize client Zoom/Google Meet call recordings, extract action items and deadlines, and draft pre-populated Asana tasks assigned to consultants with PM signoff.
problem_statement: Consultants spend 30-45 minutes post-meeting writing recap emails and creating Asana tickets; key client action items frequently get dropped.
proposed_solution: AI meeting transcription pipeline extracts structured action items with assignees and context, posting a draft summary to Slack with 1-click 'Sync to Asana' approval.
why_ai_or_why_not: LLM NLP is necessary to distill conversational audio transcripts into concise, actionable task definitions.
data_readiness_notes: High readiness: Audio recording APIs from Google Meet / Zoom are standardized.
assumptions: Consultants review and approve generated tasks in under 2 minutes.
limitations: Requires client consent disclosure for recording in accordance with two-party consent laws.

financial_inputs.notes: Saves ~142 hours of post-meeting administrative task creation.

scoring_breakdown.explanation: High business value with strong data readiness, proven delivery model, and low operational friction.

title: Internal SOP & Campaign Playbook Co-pilot for Junior Staff
description: A private RAG-powered chatbot in Slack that indexes agency SOPs, ad policy guidelines, and tracking setup playbooks to provide immediate step-by-step guidance to junior media analysts.
problem_statement: Junior analysts spend hours searching scattered Drive folders or interrupting senior consultants with repetitive questions on pixel setup and UTM conventions.
proposed_solution: Slack bot answering operational questions with exact citations to verified agency Notion/Google Drive SOPs.
why_ai_or_why_not: RAG search across qualitative SOP documentation enables natural question-answering with direct source citations.
data_readiness_notes: Moderate readiness: SOPs exist but need centralization and review for currency.
assumptions: Reduces senior consultant interruptions by 4 hours/week across the team.
limitations: Answers are only as good as the underlying documented SOPs.

financial_inputs.notes: Reduces junior research time and senior consultant interruptions.

scoring_breakdown.explanation: Substantial strategic upside; may require moderate integration effort or foundational data prep.

title: Automated Monthly Client Health & Retention Risk Predictor
description: Rule-based heuristic scoring combining Asana milestone delivery velocity, weekly KPI goal attainment, and CRM communication frequency to flag churn-risk accounts for Director intervention.
problem_statement: Client churn signals are often noticed too late (at 90-day review), leading to avoidable retainer cancellations.
proposed_solution: Weekly automated health scorecard aggregating overdue Asana tasks, Looker Studio performance trends, and days since last client contact into a green/amber/red account health dashboard.
why_ai_or_why_not: Deterministic business rules and thresholds are vastly superior and more explainable than black-box AI for churn risk flags.
data_readiness_notes: Moderate readiness: Requires connecting Asana project completion data with HubSpot contact logs.
assumptions: Early churn detection saves at least 2 retainer accounts per year ($24k-$48k annual revenue).
limitations: Cannot measure informal offline client relationships without consultant check-ins.

financial_inputs.notes: Protects high-margin retainer revenue through proactive churn alerts.

scoring_breakdown.explanation: High business value with strong data readiness, proven delivery model, and low operational friction.
